subject: Seller remittance withheld — project_tag mismatch on marketplace invoices (Alpha Integrated)
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@alpha-integrated.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: billing@alpha-integrated.com
Date: 2027-08-24T01:12:00+08:00
Subject: Withheld remittance for Aug — project_tag mismatch (Alpha Integrated)

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Quick heads-up — AWS Marketplace withheld our August remittance for seller 'Alpha Integrated' (seller_id 23-894). Marketplace flagged a project_tag mismatch between the usage records and the invoices we submitted; they classified ~USD 42,300 as unallocatable pending corrected invoice submission.

We believe this is a mapping issue: our internal project_tag (proj:ALPHA-RND) was normalized to proj:ALPHA_RND by the listing export, so AWS could not reconcile line-level usage to your merchant ledger. Finance Ops attached a sample of the disputed lines.

Can Redwood help with:
- Confirmation of the usage-feed project_tag canonicalization rules you apply when ingesting Marketplace metering files.
- A short note we can send to AWS Marketplace to justify reprocessing once we re-submit corrected invoices.

I can re-issue corrected invoices by EOD if you confirm the reconciliation expectation. This is blocking funds for two payroll cycles for us, so timely help would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Samir
Billing Manager | Alpha Integrated
attachments: seller_transaction_snapshot.csv (CSV), project_tag_map.xlsx (XLSX)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Samir Rao <samir@alpha-integrated.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-24T03:05:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Withheld remittance for Aug — project_tag mismatch (Alpha Integrated)

Samir — thanks for the context and the attachments.

Short answer: our ingestion normalizes non-alphanumeric characters in project_tag to underscores, and downstream ledger attribution prefers the canonical tag present on the listing metadata. That normalization could explain the mismatch you see (proj:ALPHA-RND -> proj_ALPHA_RND).

Action items I propose now:
1) Marissa, can you export the marketplace ingestion log for seller_id 23-894 (48–72 hour window around the disputed usage timestamps) and confirm how the tag was stored? Please include any pre-normalization values.
2) Tessa & Neha, if Redwood provides a one-paragraph reconciliation statement that confirms our normalization behavior and states that corrected invoices will be accepted for remittance reprocessing, will that satisfy AWS Marketplace requirements? If yes, we should prepare that memo and Samir can attach it to the amended invoices.
3) Samir — if you can re-submit corrected, line-level invoices by EOD I will prioritize the memo and loop in Marketplace ops for an expedited review. Also let me know whether VAT was applied differently on the submitted invoices (that can trigger additional checks).

I’ll stand up a short call if needed — otherwise we can coordinate here.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Samir Rao <samir@alpha-integrated.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-24T05:22:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Withheld remittance for Aug — project_tag mismatch (Alpha Integrated)

On Tue, 24 Aug 2027 at 03:05, jonas_weber@redwood.com wrote:
> Samir — thanks for the context and the attachments.

Attached is an initial export I pulled: seller_transaction_snapshot.csv. It contains the marketplace metering lines we ingested and the canonical tag we stored (column: stored_tag). You’ll see the normalization step in column pre_normalization_tag.

Preliminary findings:
- ~USD 42,300 of usage lines show pre_normalization_tag values with dashes or spaces; stored_tag replaces non-alphanumerics with underscores.
- The ledger attribution matched stored_tag, which is surfaced in the payout line items we publish to sellers. If your invoices referenced the pre-normalized tag (proj:ALPHA-RND) and AWS reconciles against the stored_tag (proj_ALPHA_RND), that will cause a non-match.

Recommended package to get withholding released:
A) Redwood memo (one paragraph) confirming our normalization + statement we accept corrected invoices (I can draft).
B) Seller re-submits corrected invoices that reference the stored_tag (we can provide the exact stored_tag export).
C) Evidence bundle (seller_invoice.pdf, seller_transaction_snapshot.csv) uploaded to AWS support case.

I’ve attached project_tag_map.xlsx with a mapping table. If you want, I’ll prepare the memo now and include the exact text Samir can paste into the AWS case.

-M
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
attachments: seller_transaction_snapshot.csv, project_tag_map.xlsx
From: Samir Rao <samir@alpha-integrated.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: billing@alpha-integrated.com, priya.s@alpha-integrated.com
Date: 2027-08-24T08:40:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Withheld remittance for Aug — project_tag mismatch (Alpha Integrated)

Thanks Marissa — that mapping is exactly what we needed.

We will:
- Re-issue August invoices tonight referencing the stored_tag values from your export (will attach seller_transaction_snapshot.csv and the corrected invoice PDFs).
- Upload the evidence bundle to the AWS Marketplace case (Case ID: 987654321) and add Redwood’s memorandum.

Question on VAT: our original invoices were issued net of VAT (we included a VAT line, 5%), but the ledger lines show VAT aggregated on the payout side. Will Redwood’s memo need to comment on VAT treatment to avoid a secondary hold?

Also, any chance you can send a short DocuSign release link so we can speed the remittance? Marketplace sometimes asks for a seller-signed statement.

Appreciate the rapid help.

-Samir
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Samir Rao <samir@alpha-integrated.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-25T10:03:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Withheld remittance for Aug — project_tag mismatch (Alpha Integrated)

Samir — great, thanks for the quick turnaround.

Responses inline:
- VAT: please include the VAT breakdown on the re-issued invoices exactly as shown in your original submission; we will add one sentence in the memo clarifying that Redwood does not reclass VAT during ingestion and that VAT aggregation happens at the marketplace payout layer. That should be sufficient for AWS to avoid a secondary hold.
- DocuSign: Marissa, can you generate a brief seller attestation (one-sentence) confirming the corrected invoice references stored_tag values and attach to the AWS case. I don’t think full DocuSign is necessary, but if AWS insists we can provide the DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/secure/remit-release/AA-84712.

Next steps (owner):
- Marissa: Draft the one-paragraph Redwood memo and the one-sentence seller attestation; post here for Samir to copy into the AWS case. (ETA: 3 hours)
- Samir: Re-submit invoices and upload evidence to AWS case 987654321 (ETA: EOD today local).
- Tessa / Neha: Stand by to confirm in the marketplace support thread when Redwood memo is posted so AWS can re-process quickly.

I’ll mark this as high priority internally. Once AWS confirms, we’ll track release and ensure remittance posts.

Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up if we need an escalation to the AWS Marketplace billing team.

-Jonas
